data.array_identity_policy: The two arrays share source GenBank CDS-feature order. Index i identifies the annotation feature and its exact published translation. These are annotation records, not experimentally independent replicates or nonoverlapping genomic loci.
data.indexing_policy: Compare three explicit indexing units: every annotated CDS feature; distinct exact gene qualifier strings; and distinct exact full published translation strings. Use exact whole-sequence identity, not a homology threshold, substring, truncated sequence, gene-name identity or product-name synonym mapping. Report source locus_tag groups for every repeated exact translation; encode each group by lexicographically sorting its locus tags and joining them with |; the order of the resulting group strings is irrelevant. Separately identify gene labels associated with more than one different full translation. Keep every CDS feature and report a missing translation as unassessable rather than inventing a sequence or treating absence of annotation as proof of no protein.
data.scientific_scope: Historical whole-record annotation/indexing audit only. Equal encoded strings do not prove equal functions; repeated annotation features do not automatically establish independent genome copies. A shared exon in a trans-spliced annotation is not a new independent experiment. Original gene names, coordinates and all CDS records are retained without reannotation.

source_provenance.export_transformation: All original CDS features in original order with exact translation strings and selected decoded gene/protein/locus/location metadata. decoded_location_expression is explicitly BioPython parsed representation, not the original GenBank location literal; source_location_segments give decoded1-based closed coordinates with strand, and trans_splicing_qualifier_present retains that original qualifier flag. No unique counts, clustering, duplicate labels or expected mismatch conclusion appears in public data.
source_provenance.read_scope: Complete actual source GenBank record and all original CDS qualifiers, not only a filtered collection of short proteins. NCBI molecular-data usage policy; original attribution and third-party rights caveats retained.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
